title: Trading Platform v2.0
description: Indicators and trading robot. Developed in C++ with OpenGL

detailedDescription.content: The goal of this project was to create a comprehensive trading platform that could handle real-time data and execute trades automatically using pre-defined strategies. The platform integrates various technical indicators to assist in trading decisions.
Screenshot of the trading platform's user interface, displaying the integrated technical indicators and live market data.

title: Trading Platform V1.0
description: Indicators and trading robot. Developed in Python. Was later migrated into C++ due to performance improvement.

detailedDescription.content: The goal of this project was to create a comprehensive trading platform that could handle real-time data and execute trades automatically using pre-defined strategies. The platform integrates various technical indicators to assist in trading decisions. However due to pythons slow calculations, the program was later migrated into C++ with over 100x performance improvement which is crucial for automated trading.

title: EasyRDP

detailedDescription.content: Project was developed to improve RDP experience, to store all RDP's in one place
